analyzeHint: Write freely — paragraphs are fine. ⌘Enter / Ctrl+Enter for feedback.
guidePickerLead: Choose a guide for your practice language.
grammarGuideDesc: Verb tenses and rules, from beginner to advanced.
dialectGuideDesc: Regional vocabulary, pronouns, and words to know.
waitingText:
Write a paragraph in your practice language, then press ⌘Enter / Ctrl+Enter (or Feedback).

Parlance splits it into sentences, infers CEFR level, and shows feedback here.
assessedLevelText: This sentence is at approximately {level} level.
assessedLevelRichText: Inferred around {level} on the CEFR scale — the grammar and vocabulary in this sentence fit that band.
assessedLevelHint: Inferred CEFR level for this sentence
promptLabel: Writing ideas — respond to one in your target language
analyzingParlanceOnDevice: Parlance Coach is analyzing… First on-device run can take 1–2 minutes while the model loads.
analyzingParlanceServer: Parlance Coach is analyzing… First server run may take a few minutes.
writeFirst: Write at least one paragraph first.
offline: You're offline — writing is saved locally, but cloud AI feedback requires a connection.
privacyLoadError: Unable to load the privacy policy. Try again later.
prompts_es_1: Describe your first day learning Spanish.
prompts_es_2: What does being an interpreter mean to you?
prompts_es_3: Talk about a place you would like to visit in Spain or Latin America.
prompts_es_4: Describe an important person in your life.
prompts_es_5: What are your professional goals for this year?
prompts_es_6: Write about a cultural tradition you find interesting.
prompts_es_7: What do you think about the importance of languages in today's world?
prompts_fr_1: Describe your first day learning French.
prompts_fr_2: What does being an interpreter mean to you?
prompts_fr_3: Talk about a place you would like to visit in France or a Francophone country.
prompts_fr_4: Describe an important person in your life.
prompts_fr_5: What are your professional goals for this year?
prompts_fr_6: Write about a French cultural tradition you find interesting.
prompts_fr_7: What do you think about the importance of languages in today's world?
authSetupHint: Sign in to use cloud AI without API keys.
authCloudNote: Cloud providers use your Parlance account — no API key needed.
corsWarning: This provider may block direct browser requests due to CORS restrictions. If analysis fails, try Groq, OpenAI, or Gemini — they all support browser access.
guideComingSoon: Guide coming soon for this language.
waitingParlanceOnDevice: {icon} Parlance Coach — fine-tuned model runs on this device. First analysis may take 1–2 minutes while the model loads.
waitingParlanceMissing: {icon} Parlance Coach — model not in this build. Re-archive after preparing models, or switch provider in AI settings.
waitingParlanceServer: {icon} Parlance Coach — on your Mac run the Parlance SLM server, or use the iOS app build with bundled models.
waitingWebLLM: {icon} Browser AI — first use downloads ~380 MB (cached after). Or switch to a cloud API for instant feedback.
waitingSetupProvider: Set up an AI provider to get feedback. Groq is free.
waitingAddKey: Add your {name} API key to enable feedback.
waitingCloudReady: {icon} {name} — cloud AI via your Parlance account. Write to get feedback.
errCloudTimeout: Cloud AI via Parlance account timed out. Try again or switch provider in AI settings.
errWebgpuUnavailable: WebGPU is not available in your browser. Please use Chrome 113+ or Edge 113+, or switch to a cloud provider in AI settings.
errParlanceStillWorking: Parlance Coach is still working. The first on-device run can take 1–2 minutes while the model loads — keep the app open and wait, or try a shorter sentence.
errParlanceTimeout: Parlance Coach timed out. Check that the dev server is running, or switch provider in AI settings.
errProviderTimeout: {name} timed out. Check your connection or try another provider in AI settings.
errParlanceNotBundled: Parlance Coach model is not bundled in this build. Re-archive after preparing models, or use another provider in AI settings.
errWebgpuBrowser: Your browser does not support WebGPU (needed for Browser AI). Switch to a cloud provider like Groq (free) in AI settings.
errNoApiKey: No {name} API key. Add one in AI settings.
errMonthlyLimit: Monthly limit reached (30 calls). Get 100 more calls for $0.99 in the app.
errPurchaseFailed: Purchase failed: {err}. You can try again or switch to Parlance Coach in Settings.
